title: Fit-population audit of the v7.8 ladder and HRcov, with a common-intersection sensitivity refit (review item 2)
label: audit + sensitivity analysis (post-verdict; does not replace the registered v7.8 verdict F4_CONDITIONAL)

definitions.common_start_fit_population: validation fit part: queries with timestamp id below the 70% cut of the validation timestamps (S1: all 162,066 validation queries; S2/S3: the 200,000-query HRcov validation sample)
definitions.retained: fit queries whose gold entity is among the arm pool candidates (v78_train.py: gold_pos >= 0; hcpat_train.py for HRcov: gold_pos < W = 100 after masking the bridge columns); cap 120,000 (rng 0) never binds

pools.SA: SA50: the first 100 candidates of the strict history order
pools.+C, +S, +T: PC_<base>: base top-50 followed by 50 history candidates (same candidates for the three rungs)
pools.HRcov: stored HRcov pool: base top-50 followed by <= 50 pattern-prior candidates

definitions.refit: each arm retrained on the intersection of the five arms' retained fit queries; everything else as registered: seeds 0-2, Adam 1e-3, bs 512, <= 30 epochs, patience 5 on the selection-part MRR (all selection queries, unchanged), feature standardisation recomputed on the arm's fit rows, calibrated fusion for +S, +T and HRcov, official py-tgb 2.3.0 scoring (ties averaged) of the final promoted lists
definitions.hrcov_refit: HRcov refit in the v7.8 trainer as arm HRCOV_RE (stored HRcov pool and 25 HRcov features, the hcpat_train.py recipe); its own-population re-run reproduces the stored HRcov to check the code path
definitions.bootstraps: paired, query Poisson and timestamp block, B = 2000, shared draws (seed 0); L, U = 5th / 95th percentiles (one-sided 95% bounds); BEATS / MATCHES / SMALL with bar 0.005 as registered

HRcov.pool: HRcov pool (base top-50 + <= 50 pattern candidates; stored HRCOV_PAT features)

identities_identical.+C = +S = +T: identical by construction, not recomputed row by row: the three rungs read the same pool directory (PC_tirgn) and the same gold_pos array (the tail order changes only the ranking tail); the registered trainer records equal n_fit_retained = 82138 for all three

diagnostic_size_matched_harness.note: training-only refit of each arm on a random subsample (rng 1) of its OWN fit population with the size of the common intersection; harness exact ranks of v78_train.py (not the official evaluator); registered references re-read in the same harness scale (HRcov: own-population re-run)

diagnostic_test_strata_official.note: test queries split by where the gold is (SA pool = history top-100; HRcov pool = base top-50 + pattern candidates; +C/+S/+T pool differs from the HRcov pool by <= 2% of fit queries); official per-query RR, seed mean
